svg.title: C13-M05-F2: Why a Kerberoastable account is a target
svg.desc: A flow where any user obtains a service ticket and cracks it offline, with defences of a strong key, no SPN, gMSA and AES.
svg.text: C13-M05-F2 Why a Kerberoastable account is a target
any domain user --request service ticket for SPN--> KDC
KDC --service ticket (encrypted with service acct key)--> user
user --takes ticket OFFLINE--> crack weak/RC4 key at leisure
defence: key is long+random (uncrackable) OR no SPN OR gMSA; AES not RC4
Figure C13-M05-F2. The ticket is encrypted with the service account's key, so a weak
key can be cracked offline; length and gMSAs defeat it.
